The structure of V5Co2O12 is tetragonal with space group I-4m2 (No. 119) and a 38-atom unit cell (V20Co8O24) across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis gives octahedral CoO6 environments and five-coordinate V centers, with Co–O distances of 1.82–2.19 Å and V–O distances of 1.87–2.13 Å. Oxygen is three-coordinate, surrounded by two Co and one V or one Co and two V. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Co octahedra, and corner-sharing between Co octahedra and V five-vertex polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional periodic network.
